title: Public bridge exposure policy
objective: Keep research-derived candidates visible without allowing a six-item bridge family to dominate the established seam-DNA style.

rationale: L1 default natural share is already about 13.6%, so no increase is needed.
L2 default natural share is about 23.1%, which would overrepresent one new family.
A 15% cap preserves discoverability while keeping the existing seam corpus dominant.

invariants: No bridge candidate is removed from the public whitelist.
The 10-item comparison pool may still include bridge candidates normally.
Only random one-shot seam generation is throttled.
If either standard or bridge pool is empty, use the non-empty pool.
The cap may be revised after observed usage/quality review.

expected_effect.L1_default: approximately unchanged; natural share below cap
expected_effect.L2_default: bridge draw probability reduced from ~23% to 15%
